EBITDA stood at INR 239 crores compared to INR110 crores in Q1 FY26, delivering an impressive 118% growth.
Growth & demand: Andhra Pradesh alone grew revenue 62% year-on-year with an SSG of 49.1%, while our Telangana up-country market grew at 48% with an SSG of 40%, and even our large established Hyderabad city base grew by 34% with an SSG of 32.3%.
